novelty.justification: The novelty route is a quantitative measurement adaptation: the claim proposes that a representation is load-bearing only when a “minimal, targeted edit” causes the “scientifically predicted counterfactual change,” summarized by a new “mechanistic fidelity” ratio. Searches for “counterfactual representation intervention quantitative scientific law,” “physics foundation model concept direction steering,” and “probe direction causal use” identify AlterRep (Ravfogel et al., 2021), causal abstraction/interchange-intervention work by Geiger et al., and Physics Steering (2025) as the closest precedents; these already edit decoded features and assess whether outputs change consistently with linguistic rules or physical concepts. Moving from those works to exact theory-predicted response curves across scientific models is a substantive multi-step operationalization and new quantitative standard, but it is a natural extension of established causal representation editing rather than a new core intervention paradigm.
